api-url.tooltip: Base URL of the Clankermux management API, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080 or http://clankermux.example.test:8080

connection-note.description: The applet reads /health?detail=1 and /api/accounts. Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS URL above; hostnames and IP addresses are both supported. Clankermux management endpoints do not require an API key, so prefer localhost, a trusted LAN, or an SSH tunnel.

panel-bar-width.description: Width of each panel progress bar

warning-threshold.description: Turn pooled bars orange at this projected usage
warning-threshold.tooltip: A single account at risk does not change a pooled bar. Red is reserved for confident exhaustion of the whole pool.

show-scoped-limits.description: Show model-specific limits in the panel and popup

primary-first.description: Put the currently selected account first
